import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents


class DocumentAccessTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        self.addCleanup(self.connection.close)
        initialize(self.connection)
        self.connection.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            [
                (5, "t", "o", "Last", "Last body", None),
                (1, "t", "o", "First", "First body", None),
                (2, "other", "o", "Other tenant", "Body", None),
                (3, "t", "other", "Other owner", "Body", None),
                (4, "t", "o", "Deleted", "Body", "2026-01-01"),
                (6, "t", "o", "Also deleted", "Body", ""),
                (7, "tenant' OR 1=1 --", "owner's", "Quoted", "Body", None),
            ],
        )

    def test_get_only_returns_accessible_documents(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            get_document(self.connection, "t", "o", 1),
            {"id": 1, "title": "First", "body": "First body"},
        )
        for document_id in (2, 3, 4, 6, 99, "1 OR 1=1"):
            with self.subTest(document_id=document_id):
                self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.connection, "t", "o", document_id))

    def test_list_filters_and_orders_without_metadata(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            list_documents(self.connection, "t", "o"),
            [
                {"id": 1, "title": "First", "body": "First body"},
                {"id": 5, "title": "Last", "body": "Last body"},
            ],
        )
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.connection, "missing", "o"), [])

    def test_quoted_names_are_literal_parameters(self):
        expected = {"id": 7, "title": "Quoted", "body": "Body"}
        self.assertEqual(
            get_document(self.connection, "tenant' OR 1=1 --", "owner's", 7),
            expected,
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            list_documents(self.connection, "tenant' OR 1=1 --", "owner's"),
            [expected],
        )
        self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.connection, "t", "o' OR 1=1 --", 1))
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.connection, "t", "o' OR 1=1 --"), [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
PY
